title: Post-Suasion: Aftereffects
coreMove: Convert a momentary yes into a lasting pattern by designing what happens immediately after attention has done its work.
sourcePressure: The source says pre-suaders want temporary attention shifts to become durable and that two kinds of procedures can help initially generated changes take root.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Once the person agrees, the influence work is done.

hook: An abstract claim that attention changes everything
A generic meeting where someone makes a better pitch
A clever sentence about persuasion before any concrete object appears
counterintuition: You think persuasion happens during the ask, but it happens before it
The obvious factor is not always the important one
Influence is not manipulation when used well
tryThisNow: Set a timer and reflect on attention
Write down three ways to be more persuasive
Ask yourself what matters most right now

exampleSpecs.audience: an auditor trying to make a conservation yes last past the visit
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the next action is locked in while attention is still warm
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the auditor schedules the insulation quote before leaving the attic hatch, not three days later by email
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a pull-down attic ladder under a work light

exampleSpecs.audience: a dietitian helping a patient preserve a fresh decision
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the first durable procedure happens before the patient exits
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the dietitian has the patient place one usual breakfast item on a swap card before checkout
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a breakfast swap card beside a glucose meter case

exampleSpecs.audience: a development officer making a verbal pledge take root
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the commitment gets an immediate public or procedural anchor
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the officer asks the donor to choose the exhibit label wording before the pledge card goes into a folder
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a draft exhibit label on cream stock

exampleSpecs.audience: an instructor turning a burst of motivation into weekly practice
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the next session is placed on the student’s actual calendar
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the instructor watches the student block Tuesday’s practice while the solved bug is still on screen
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a laptop showing a fixed test beside an open calendar

exampleSpecs.audience: a building manager making a corrected sorting choice stick
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the first correct behavior is repeated and marked immediately
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the manager has residents sort one real item at the mailroom station and take a printed bin guide
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a mailroom table with three labeled sample items

exampleSpecs.audience: a conductor turning recital excitement into durable practice
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the child leaves with a named cue and first repetition
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the conductor has the student play the opening four bars once more and attach practice to tuning the stand light
exampleSpecs.firstImage: sheet music under a small stand light

skillTargets: convert momentary receptivity into a next action
anchor a fresh yes before it cools
choose a procedure that helps change take root

tryThisNowSpec: After a fresh yes, schedule or perform the next concrete action immediately while the reason for saying yes is still visible.
